- Added new code to disable leaderboards when irrelevant/not required
- Minor changes to localisation files for Game Descriptions

notes.title: ICEBOX:Speedgunner Winter Challenge!
notes.notes:
[h1]MEDIA ALERT FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE[/h1]

    [b]WHAT[/b] : “ICEBOX: Speedgunner” Winter Challenge On Steam
    [b]WHO[/b] : All players
    [b]WHEN[/b] : Jan 8-14 2018 


[h1]THE INAUGURAL SPEEDGUNNER![/h1]

ICEBOX: SPEEDGUNNER WINTER CHALLENGE IS GO! COMPETE IN THIS SPECIAL EVENT ON STEAM TO BE CROWNED THE INAUGURAL SPEEDGUNNER AND WIN YOURSELF A PRIZE.

Adelaide, Australia (ACDT) Jan 3 2018 - Developer Games Of Edan today announced the scheduled release of “ICEBOX: Speedgunner” V1.2 in readiness for the Winter Challenge Special Event being held via Steam. (Note: It's possible to try out the new version now by activating the game's Beta Steam branch).

The Winter Challenge is a brand new level to compete on for a very limited time. At the event conclusion on Jan 15, the leaderboard is locked and winner announced. Games of Edan will then send the winner a prize (The winner’s prize will comprise steam keys for a random selection of games).

[h1]ABOUT VERSION 1.2.x[/h1]

In the v1.2.x release, we now support the Simplified Chinese language, making a total of 7 languages now supported by the game.

For all the other patch notes, please read the separate post.

[h1]MORE INFORMATION[/h1]

ICEBOX: Speedgunner sees the player carving an ice-cool path through a brand new 3D Platforming FPS, cutting corners, dodging obstacles & eliminating sentinels, in a battle to escape the ICEBOX, before it’s permanently shut down. The player will race the clock, hunt the Central AI and leverage run-and-gun gameplay to navigate a digital labyrinth, top the global leaderboards and become the Ultimate Speedgunner. Inspired by the “Brain in a Vat” thought-experiment, the game explores the concept of escaping your own virtual prison.

[h1]QUICK INFO[/h1]
[list]
[*]    WEBSITE: http://www.gamesofedan.com/icebox-speedgunner
[*]    PRESSKIT: http://www.indiedb.com/games/icebox/presskit
[*]    PREVIEWS/REVIEWS: Request a code via distribute() at https://dodistribute.com/access/p2raeWY4RM/
[*]    EMAIL: Please contact icebox@gamesofedan.com
[*]    TWITTER: @gamesofedan
[/list]

#######

notes.title: v1.1.9 Update now available for Win/Mac/Linux
notes.notes:
Version 1.1.9 is now out on Steam - The first public release for Mac and Linux - so now everyone can compete on the global leaderboards. 

[img=http://78.media.tumblr.com/9ae0639fd99ce020daf4ca917f5dd9b5/tumblr_inline_oz6fjxhhcD1risngf_500.jpg]

[h1]News Tab[/h1]
A major update sees the [i]Steam News Tab[/i] on the Main Menu, primarily for announcing and managing Seasonal Tournaments. The first one will be Jan 8-14. So be sure to play the game during that week and compete on the special Winter 2018 level to be crowned the Inaugural Winter Champion! There will be more updates soon as we prepare for this special event.

Hopefully in the future, with interest from the community, these events can be further celebrated with more new content.

[h1]Menus[/h1]
We've updated the game menus - especially the game select screen - to simplify management of existing and new content. All menus can now also be navigated using the arrow keys or the controller (when selected).

[h1]Czech Localisation[/h1]
Thanks to the excellent help from Ondřej, one of our community members, we have now added Czech localisation, making a total of 6 languages now supported.

If you come across any issues with the latest update, please send an email to iceboxATgamesofedanDOTcom

Thank you for supporting the game!
NB: [url=http://gamesofedan.com/post/167729826172/icebox-speedgunner-available-now-for-mac-linux]The full press release is available on our website.[/url]

notes.title: Streamers - How to insert your avatar into the game.
notes.notes:
Did you know that you can insert your own logo/avatar into the game? Follow these steps and see your logo randomly pop up in the ICEBOX.

More hints and tips can be found in the README.txt which is also included in the first news post for your convenience.

[img=http://78.media.tumblr.com/c1de35d2cd69339c10deda2575541db8/tumblr_inline_oygjgfBv1k1risngf_500.jpg]

[b]CUSTOMISING THE GAME WITH YOUR AVATAR[/b]
To add your own custom avatar/logo/image into the game, follow these steps:
[list]
    [*]Create a folder called 'Custom' inside the game's install folder.
    [*]Copy a square image (eg 512x512) to the folder and name it "logo.png"
    eg. For Windows, copy your image file to "Icebox_Data/Custom/logo.png" inside the Icebox install folder
    [*]That's it! The game will randomly select your image and replace some wall/floor decals.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 1.0.30 Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

[b]v1.0.30 is now available on Steam[/b].
It includes some small changes to the game. Read on to find out what’s inside.

[img=http://78.media.tumblr.com/1ec357e63c81951f9b00790bcd6e2c3b/tumblr_inline_oyge097dvN1risngf_500.gif]

The main changes involve reduced timeouts on Steam Leaderboards & fixing a bug where Leaderboards would be 'double-loaded' in Steam.

Hopefully most of these changes should not create any noticeable differences to players, but if you do come across an issue please send an email to icebox@gamesofedan.com

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue with double-loading leaderboard for Steam version
[*]Reduced leaderboard timeout to 10s. Sometimes Steam can take it's time updating the leaderboard. Hopefully the previous bullet point will help.
[*]Preparing OSX & Linux builds
[*]Changed default Cursor dimensions to make for a reasonable size on OSX
[*]Changed File Verification system to operate differently for different platforms.
[*]Minor changes to the key-binding controls menu.
[*]Adding Czech translations. Still more work needs to be done here. 
[/list]

Thank you for supporting the game!

notes.title: Welcome!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

[b]WELCOME[/b]
Welcome to our community hub! Please remember to always be civil and courteous to one another (and myself) in all correspondence & I'm sure we'll all have a great time together.


[b]TIPS[/b]
Below is a copy of the included README.txt file you can find in the game's install folder. It includes a few tips and notes for getting the best performance on your system, and has some contact information for sending official bug reports.

====================================
[b]README.txt ... ICEBOX:SPEEDGUNNER[/b]
====================================

----------------------------
[b]BUG REPORTS / FEATURE REQUESTS[/b]
----------------------------
Please send official bug reports & feature requests to: icebox@gamesofedan.com
Be sure to include your Computer Specifications, detailed info about the bug & supporting screenshots.

----------------------------
[b]PERFORMANCE SUGGESTIONS[/b]
----------------------------
Depending upon your setup, here's a few ideas for getting the best performance.

HARD DRIVES (HDD)/SOLID-STATE-DRIVES (SSD)/RAMDisk/USB
[list]
[*]The game will happily run from a standard HDD. However, it works even better from an SSD, since it streams data from disk.
[*]Note: If you install to a slow HDD, you may experience stuttering as data loads into the game.
[*]If you have a slow HDD and no SSD, then try using a RAMDisk like http://www.radeonramdisk.com or installing to a USB flash drive - these may be faster than slow HDDs.
[/list]

[b]GRAPHICS SETTINGS[/b]
[list]
[*]Experiment with the other graphics settings to accomodate the performance of your graphics card.
[*]For example, reducing the resolution can significantly reduce the workload on your graphics card.
[/list]

[b]VERTICAL SYNCRONISATION[/b]
[list]
[*]Try turning VSync off (ie. set to 0) in the Graphics settings, to support higher frame rates (eg > 60FPS).
[*]NOTE: Turning off VSync may cause screen tearing/sttuters on monitors that cannot support higher frame rates.
[*]On lower-end systems/monitors, it may be better to turn VSync up instead. This locks the frame rate to a lower value (eg. at 60FPS/30FPS) which can be better on lower-spec graphics cards 
[/list]

----------------------------
[b]WINDOWED MODE[/b]
----------------------------
To start the game in Windowed mode follow these steps:
[list]
[*]Hold Shift when starting the game to open the Configuration Window
[*]Select the "Windowed Mode" option
[*]Press 'Play' to start the game
[*]Your selection will be remembered between sessions
[/list]

----------------------------
[b]MULTI-MONITOR SETUPS[/b]
----------------------------
To specify which monitor to use for the game's display, open the game's Configuration Window during startup:
[list]
[*]Hold Shift when starting the game to open the Configuration Window
[*]Change the default Display to your choosing
[*]Press 'Play' to start the game
[*]Your selection will be remembered between sessions
[/list]

----------------------------
[b]CUSTOMISING THE GAME WITH YOUR AVATAR[/b]
----------------------------
To add your own custom avatar/logo/image into the game, follow these steps:
[list]
[*]Create a folder called 'Custom' inside the game's install folder.
[*]Copy a square image (eg 512x512) to the folder and name it "logo.png"
[*]eg. For Windows, copy your image file to "Icebox_Data/Custom/logo.png" inside the Icebox install folder
[*]That's it! The game will randomly select your image and replace some wall/floor decals.
[/list]

----------------------------
[b]SETTINGS FILE[/b]
----------------------------
The Settings.txt is saved to disk at different locations for each OS/platforms. On Windows, it's located at "$USER/AppData/LocalLow/Games Of Edan/Icebox/Data/Settings/Settings.txt"

----------------------------
[b]CONTROLLER DEADZONES[/b]
----------------------------
At present, only the XBox 360 controller is supported in game. Some controllers may drift due to age or manufacturing, which results in the camera drifting or the player moving when no inputs are supplied. The game uses preset deadzones for each 'axis', but if you find that your controller still drifts, then try increasing the deadzone values in the game's Settings.txt file. NB: The Settings.txt file will be created automatically after your first play.

----------------------------
[b]LOCAL LEADERBOARDS[/b]
----------------------------
Local leaderboards are used when you play offline (ie. No internet access available). They are saved to a file under the AppData folder, which is platform dependent. On Windows, it's located at "$USER/AppData/LocalLow/Games Of Edan/Icebox/Data/Leaderboards"

You can reset the local leaderboards by deleting the files located inside the abovementioned folder.

----------------------------
[b]LOCAL TOURNAMENTS[/b]
----------------------------
When playing offline (ie. disconnected from the internet Steam/Gamejolt leaderboards) local leaderboards are used instead. Players can enter their own name when starting each level.

This makes an easy way for hosting a local tournament/competition/event,
where each player can log their own score to the "local leaderboard",
much like an arcade machine high-scores.

----------------------------
[b]SAVE FILES[/b]
----------------------------
Your save files are generated when reaching a checkpoint in game.
They are saved to a file under the AppData folder, which is platform dependent. On Windows, it's located at "$USER/AppData/LocalLow/Games Of Edan/Icebox/Data/Saves"

You can clear the old saves by deleting the files located inside the abovementioned folder.

[*]Hold Shift when starting the game to open the Configuration Window
[*]Select the "Windowed Mode" option
[*]Press 'Play' to start the game
[*]Your selection will be remembered between sessions
[/list]

----------------------------
[b]MULTI-MONITOR SETUPS[/b]
----------------------------
To specify which monitor to use for the game's display, open the game's Configuration Window during startup:
[list]
[*]Hold Shift when starting the game to open the Configuration Window
[*]Change the default Display to your choosing
[*]Press 'Play' to start the game
[*]Your selection will be remembered between sessions
[/list]

----------------------------
[b]CUSTOMISING THE GAME WITH YOUR AVATAR[/b]
----------------------------
To add your own custom avatar/logo/image into the game, follow these steps:
[list]
[*]Create a folder called 'Custom' inside the game's install folder.
[*]Copy a square image (eg 512x512) to the folder and name it "logo.png"
[*]eg. For Windows, copy your image file to "Icebox_Data/Custom/logo.png" inside the Icebox install folder
[*]That's it! The game will randomly select your image and replace some wall/floor decals.
[/list]

----------------------------
[b]SETTINGS FILE[/b]
----------------------------
The Settings.txt is saved to disk at different locations for each OS/platforms. On Windows, it's located at "$USER/AppData/LocalLow/Games Of Edan/Icebox/Data/Settings/Settings.txt"

----------------------------
[b]CONTROLLER DEADZONES[/b]
----------------------------
At present, only the XBox 360 controller is supported in game. Some controllers may drift due to age or manufacturing, which results in the camera drifting or the player moving when no inputs are supplied. The game uses preset deadzones for each 'axis', but if you find that your controller still drifts, then try increasing the deadzone values in the game's Settings.txt file. NB: The Settings.txt file will be created automatically after your first play.

----------------------------
[b]LOCAL LEADERBOARDS[/b]
----------------------------
Local leaderboards are used when you play offline (ie. No internet access available). They are saved to a file under the AppData folder, which is platform dependent. On Windows, it's located at "$USER/AppData/LocalLow/Games Of Edan/Icebox/Data/Leaderboards"

You can reset the local leaderboards by deleting the files located inside the abovementioned folder.

----------------------------
[b]LOCAL TOURNAMENTS[/b]
----------------------------
When playing offline (ie. disconnected from the internet Steam/Gamejolt leaderboards) local leaderboards are used instead. Players can enter their own name when starting each level.

This makes an easy way for hosting a local tournament/competition/event,
where each player can log their own score to the "local leaderboard",
much like an arcade machine high-scores.

----------------------------
[b]SAVE FILES[/b]
----------------------------
Your save files are generated when reaching a checkpoint in game.
They are saved to a file under the AppData folder, which is platform dependent. On Windows, it's located at "$USER/AppData/LocalLow/Games Of Edan/Icebox/Data/Saves"

You can clear the old saves by deleting the files located inside the abovementioned folder.
